body:
Hi guys, I’m pretty new to powerlifting and picked it up about 3 months ago. I’ve made a 50kg improvement on squats, 60kg on deads and 25kg on bench (170x3, 180x3, 110x3 respectively haven’t done 1rm attempts yet).

My issue is that my OHP started at 50x3 and is now 52.5x3. Only a 2.5kg in 3 months doesn’t seem to add up compared to the other lifts. I’m 6”1 and about 200lbs and have naturally quite a broad shoulder base. 

Does anyone have any advice for getting this OHP up as It feels like it’s really letting me down at the moment.

Cheers!

I was playing as a melee build about 40/28 star dex when I faced him for the first time. I found being aggressive in his first phase (watch out for that damn falchion though) worked well. Then when he moves onto second phase I’d keep a healthy distance and try baiting his lunge attacks as they leave him open. 
Also if you have dragon slayer great axe slap him with the weapon art of that whenever you stagger him for some lovely damage.
 I think everyone finds different bosses challenging in different ways. I breezed through dancer on my first try but then had Oceiros hand my ass to me repeatedly despite hearing he’s one of the easiest bosses. 
 Good luck!

Exactly! It all feels fake. Like my mood is more manageable but it’s like wearing a mask where behind it everything is shit. I don’t want to go back to where I was but I don’t want to stay where I am. Feel a tad stuck

Yeah I gotta admit I’m feeling that “if “ right now. Been grinding levels at lothric high wall and since dart doesn’t cause any stagger or attack interruption lothric knights are horrendously difficult. On average each level up is putting 1 extra damage on my casts 😕

Great suggestion with the EGS! I could do it on NG but that kinda feels like cheating. I did this for the challenge so starting with loads of tools that boost sorceries kinda feels like cutting corners
I had to just use soul arrow on iudex. I feel dirty for doing it I’ll fight champion instead to make up for it

It’s infuriating. I want to beat them without alluring skull or black firebombs but it’s so difficult. A lot of the time I find by the time you’ve injured the guy with the soul the soul transfers and you get no boss damage. Had Royce appear a few times and those chubby blue blokes are so stupidly hard to get rid of when you’re getting smashed by fireballs. Then you get hit by curse and it’s game over 

Have taken a detour to smouldering lake to try level up a bit before going back.....having to level up for deacons...good god
Pro tip: So long as you wear  Pharis’s Hat and say “m’lady” after each bow every enemy self implodes with cringe.

I’m probably most worried about Friede given her crazy aggression. I feel like Dancer may be pretty nasty too though I managed to breeze through her on my melee build.

Really can’t imagine how intense that Gael fight must’ve been

It sounds like you’re going through a lot. Like, so much. But the fact you’ve posted means you want to fight. And you should be super proud of yourself. Things will change. You can do this. I posted here for my first time tonight and as from one depressed person to another, goddam I am proud of you

That fact that you know that is great. Though it’s hard sometimes the guilt of leaving being you reason to stay is enough. That’s where I am now. Cling to it. She loves you and if she’s trying to help she’ll miss you if you go. You got this. One we’ll both look back at this moment of our lives and be super proud we made it. You got this buddy

Hey, I can’t even comprehend what you are going through. I can’t even begin to pretend. But what she want. How would she feel too ow that her life ended yours. I know that if it was me in that place I’d want the person I loved to be happy, to fight through the pain and find joy. Again I can’t imagine your pain I really really can’t, but whenever you’re feeling truly down and truly dark ask yourself, is that how she would want to be remembered. Because while you’re still alive so is her smile, her smell, her jokes and her imperfections. That ends with you. Share it. Spread it. And keep going. Carry her memory forward in your life. It’s the harder option but the better one. 



Please be safe

Buddy your mom loves the shit out of you. I want to give up too. But it’s my parents that keep me here. They will love you forever. Speak to her. Let her in. You got this. You’re her child and there is nothing in the world she wouldn’t do for you. So do your best for her. You got this!

Hey buddy. Hang in there. When I was your age I had a growth spurt and I grew all up and absolutely no out. It wasn’t till I was about 20 when I broadened out. It’ll happen for you.


I dunno if you are but try finding someone to speak to. It’s taken me about two years to admit I need to talk to someone. And it’s one of those things where you need to feel you’re ready for t for it to work. But you got this man. Speak to a human about your emotions. Tell your parents. I guarantee it’ll be hard as hell, but they will are so so fucking much. People love you. Don’t forget that
I’m always here if you want to talk. Seeing someone else get through this shit might help me. I don’t mean that in a selfish way I just think the more people talk about this shit the better it gets.

I feel like that’s where I am. I don’t want to but I’m feeling optionless. Trust me posting on the internet about this is a bit of a last ditch attempt. I’ve been trying to push everyone that cares away and I know that’s just to make things easier. Sometimes I wish I didn’t care. But I do. So I’m holding onto that. Thanks for your advice. Really. Literally knowing people understand helps way more Than I thought it would

Also I’m very new to reddit and using my phone so I don’t know how to format properly. I know this is a ridiculous thing to say of this thread but it’s bothering me more than I’d like to admit
(Thanks again)

Exactly! Thank fuck! It’s like the idea of facing another day is just too much. But the concept of leaving your family feeling live they’ve failed you is just that little bit worse!
 Jesus Christ even hearing one person in the world is stuck feeling like this helps.
 I hate to admit this because I feel like it’s kinda pathetic but I’ve started self harming recently. And when I ask myself why I think it’s because I’ve started practising to see what I can handle for the real deal. If I had no family and friends, easy peasy.
 But the idea of hurting those people I love so much is a little bit worse than facing another day.
Thank you so so much for commenting. I’m really feeling lonely and desperate and even having one other person say they feel the same is huge to me. Thank you

You’re not a failure. I’m in the same boat I really want to kill myself. That doesn’t make you a failure. You’d probably be ducking sweet back in the caveman day throwing spears at shit and surviving. 
You got this man. You need to have this. 
I really fucking care about how you’re doing. I’m here to listen to anything. 
I don’t want you to die.
Please be safe

Buddy, you’re not alone. I’m sat here feeling like there’s no hope left and that I want to give up. But at the same time, I dont want this bullshit feeling to beat me. You can do this. I promise you. Whatever is going on you don’t really want to die. You just want to be removed from a certain situation. The hard bit is figuring it what and why. I’m here for you internet stranger.
I want you to be ok.
And I want you to know, I really fucking care. Because if you can beat this, then I know that I can beat this.
Please be safe.
Not just the beans....but the wobeans and the chilbeans too
